name: idle-compact
description: Compacts Claude Code sessions that have sat idle too long. Claude Code's built-in auto-compact fires on how full the context is; this fires on how long a session has been untouched — after 45 minutes idle it types a real /compact into the session, so you come back to one that has already tidied itself instead of one that stalls the moment you type. Works on desktop-app and background sessions via `claude attach`, and on terminal sessions via tmux, yakuake, or Konsole.
